headline: Hindalco Q2 net profit jumps 58.8% to ₹7,533 cr on strong EBITDA
hook: Profit up 58.8% on steady non-LME earnings
summary: Hindalco reported a 58.8% year-on-year rise in September-quarter net profit to ₹7,533 crore, driven by a 42% increase in EBITDA to ₹13,757 crore. The company stated that non-LME-linked businesses contributed nearly half of its earnings and expects coal-related cost pressures to ease in the upcoming quarter. Shares closed 1.88% higher following the results. Strong operational performance and easing input costs directly impact metal sector sentiment for retail investors.
whats_next: Q3 results and easing coal cost impact in Q4
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly earnings boost metals sector sentiment.
winners_losers: Hindalco holders gain / raw material cost pressures ease
